description:
Let the graph traits yield dependency ids as borrowed string views, so a node can store typed ids without changing the graph algorithms.

## Background

`GraphNode::dependencies(&self) -> &[String]` (`crates/jit/src/graph/mod.rs:45-51`) and `HierarchyNode::dependencies` (`graph/hierarchy.rs:158-168`) force each implementor to store a `Vec<String>`. Implementors are `Issue` (`domain/types.rs:814`), `EdgeView` (`graph/hierarchy.rs:493`), `ProspectiveNode` (`commands/template_expand.rs:457`), whose placeholder ids are `__apply_placeholder__:{role}` (`:435`), and the test nodes `TestNode` (`graph/mod.rs:585`), `PropNode` (`graph/hierarchy.rs:1106`) and `FixtureNode` (`crates/jit/tests/fast_issue/hierarchy_vectors_test.rs:41`), which read non-UUID ids such as `r-t1` from the hierarchy test vectors. Placeholder and vector ids are not issue ids, so the traits stay independent of the issue-id type. The MSRV (1.97) supports return-position `impl Trait` in traits.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GraphNode::dependencies` and `HierarchyNode::dependencies` return an iterator of `&str` instead of a slice of `String`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each implementor compiles against the new signature without changing the type of the ids it stores, and placeholder and test-vector nodes keep their non-UUID ids.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing graph property tests pass with unchanged assertions.
title: Graph node traits expose dependency ids as string views
